ev_to_ebitda.reason: EV/EBITDA is not an insurer-standard valuation measure.

ev_to_ebit.reason: Enterprise value is economically misleading for insurers, on the same grounds as EV/EBITDA.

ev_to_fcf.reason: Industrial FCF is not comparable for insurers.

return_on_invested_capital.reason: Insurer leverage and float make generic ROIC misleading.

gross_profits_to_assets.reason: Insurers report no gross-profit line; premiums less claims is underwriting income.

free_cash_flow_yield.reason: Industrial FCF is distorted by premiums, claims, reserves and investment flows.

cash_conversion.reason: Claims reserves break industrial earnings-to-cash comparisons.

net_debt_to_ebitda.reason: EBITDA leverage is not an insurer solvency measure.

current_ratio.reason: Insurer liquidity and solvency require statutory measures.

altman_z.reason: Industrial bankruptcy model is not calibrated for insurers.

trailing_revenue_growth.reason: Metric registry does not declare this profile applicable.

capex_to_depreciation.reason: Physical reinvestment is not the insurer value-creation engine.

piotroski_f.reason: Generic accounting checklist omits underwriting and reserve quality.

days_sales_outstanding_trend.reason: Receivable days do not represent insurer underwriting quality.
